name: Miro
tagline: Online collaborative whiteboard for brainstorming, diagramming, and workshops
verdictSummary: An infinite canvas with shapes, sticky notes, and freehand drawing is buildable with a canvas library (tldraw or Excalidraw). But Miro's real complexity is multiplayer — real-time collaboration with cursor presence, the template marketplace, integrations, and advanced features like voting, timers, and facilitation tools. A basic canvas is easy; multiplayer at scale is hard.
coreLoopDIY: Infinite canvas with shapes, sticky notes, text, and freehand drawing
moatNotes: CRDT-based multiplayer on an infinite canvas is the deep engineering challenge — it's not the shapes, it's the sync
whyPeopleStillPay: Real-time collaboration at scale, plus the template ecosystem for running workshops and design sprints
notes: tldraw is an excellent open-source base for a Miro clone. Add multiplayer and you have a solid MVP.
